footer.intro: The only hotel directly on Lake St. Moritz. Family-run, open every day of the year.
footer.newsletterText: Seasonal dinners, rare bottlings and quiet weeks on the lake — a few times a year.
hotel.tagline: On the shore of Lake St. Moritz since 1885
meta.description: The only hotel directly on Lake St. Moritz. Family-run since 1885, home of Devil's Place — Guinness World Record holder for the world's largest whisky selection — and 1,300+ fine wines.
meta.title: Hotel Waldhaus am See · St. Moritz — On the lake since 1885
newsletter.label: Email address
newsletter.thanks: Thank you — our letters from the lake will find you.
notFound.heading: Lost in the Engadin
notFound.lead: This path leads nowhere — but the lake is always a short walk away.
notFound.title: Page not found · Waldhaus am See, St. Moritz
rooms.apartment-suite.description.0: Our most generous accommodation: 3.5-room apartments and suites, very exclusively furnished, each with two separate bedrooms and a living room opening onto a balcony or terrace.
rooms.apartment-suite.description.1: A full bathroom, separate WC with shower and a private kitchen make them ideal for families, friends travelling together, or anyone staying a little longer.
rooms.apartment-suite.features.1: Living room with balcony or terrace
rooms.apartment-suite.name: Apartment · Suite
rooms.apartment-suite.short: 3.5 rooms, exclusively furnished, with balcony or terrace — for families and longer stays.
rooms.double-comfort.description.0: Our comfort doubles look out over the village of St. Moritz or into the quiet of the forest. No two are identical — layout, orientation and style differ from room to room.
rooms.double-comfort.description.1: Traditional Engadin wood meets modern bathrooms, renovated as part of our ongoing investment in the house.
rooms.double-comfort.name: Double Room · Comfort
rooms.double-comfort.short: Spacious and warm, overlooking the village or the forest.
rooms.double-lake-view.description.0: The view that made the Waldhaus famous: straight across Lake St. Moritz towards the peaks of Maloja, with nothing but water between you and the mountains.
rooms.double-lake-view.description.1: Warm wood, soft linens and a bathroom renovated in recent years. Ask for an upper floor for the widest panorama.
rooms.double-lake-view.name: Double Room · Lake View
rooms.double-lake-view.short: The signature room — the only hotel directly on the lake, and it shows.
rooms.single-lake-view.description.0: A generous single room facing Lake St. Moritz, with views across the water to the village and the mountains towards Maloja.
rooms.single-lake-view.description.1: The bathroom offers a bath or rain shower; the furnishings are warm alpine wood, each room with its own character.
rooms.single-lake-view.name: Single Room · Lake View
rooms.single-lake-view.short: Wake up to the lake — the village and the Maloja peaks framed in your window.
rooms.single.description.0: Small but beautifully considered. Every single room has been completely renovated, with a new bathroom featuring either a bathtub or a rain shower.
rooms.single.description.1: Windows open onto the rooftops of St. Moritz or the larch forest behind the hotel — a quiet, restful base for the solo traveller.
rooms.single.name: Single Room
rooms.single.short: Small, cosy and completely renovated — a quiet retreat in Swiss stone pine.
timeline.1885.text: The Waldhaus opens its doors on the shore of Lake St. Moritz — the only hotel directly on the water.
timeline.1885.title: The house opens
timeline.1985.text: A century later, Claudio Bernasconi acquires the hotel and begins shaping its singular character.
timeline.1985.title: The Bernasconi era
timeline.1996.text: Devil's Place enters the Guinness Book of Records with 1,000 bottles of whisky.
timeline.1996.title: First world record
timeline.1999.text: A second Guinness entry with more than 2,500 bottlings — a record held ever since.
timeline.1999.title: The record grows
timeline.2013.text: 11 new rooms, 25 new bathrooms, 105 new beds, a new entrance, dining room and the Sela Guardalej.
timeline.2013.title: CHF 2.2 million renewal
timeline.2019.text: A complete renovation of the wellness area, 25 further rooms and 20 bathrooms, and a wider window front in the restaurant.
timeline.2019.title: CHF 3 million renewal
timeline.today.text: Claudio's son Sandro leads the house — the tradition, and the welcome, live on.
timeline.today.title: The next generation
